meta.candidate_rule: every column declared INTEGER/REAL/float in all 428 tables, minus unique-per-row integer identifiers (*Id) and minus declared BOOLEAN/LocalizedText/TEXT flag/text columns
meta.classification_heuristics: Ordered first-match keyword rules on UPPER(column_name); per-field 'matched' records the keyword. Order: 1) table-scope: table in {GameSpeeds,GameSpeed_Scalings,GameSpeed_Durations,GameSpeed_Turns,Difficulties} or table=='GlobalParameters' -> global_intensity. 2) COST|MAINTENANCE|PRICE -> cost. 3) CHANCE|ODDS|PROBABILITY|WEIGHT|RANDOM|ROLL -> chance. 4) TURN|DURATION|TIMER|THROTTLE|FADE|RAMP -> duration_timer. 5) MAX|MIN|CAP|LIMIT|SLOT -> cap. 6) THRESHOLD|EXPONENT|PROGRESS -> progression_threshold. 7) STRENGTH|COMBAT|DEFENSE|MOVEMENT|SIGHT|HITPOINT|CHARGE|DAMAGE|RANGE|BOMBARD|FORTIF|HEAL -> base_stat. 8) YIELD|BONUS|MODIFIER|AMOUNT|PERCENT|MULTIPL|POINT|GOLD|FAITH|SCIENCE|CULTURE|TOURISM|LOYALTY|APPEAL|HOUSING|HAPPINESS|GRIEVANCE|PLUNDER|PILLAGE|PRESSURE|STOCKPILE|FERTILITY|FAVOR|VALUE|POWER|SCORE -> bonus_magnitude. 9) REQUIRE|PREREQ|LEVEL|EXCLUSIV|OBSOLETE|VALID|ALLOW|ELIGIB -> requirement_filter. 10) TYPE|KIND|CLASS|DOMAIN|TAG|AGENDA -> selector. 11) FLAVOR|PRIORITY|BIAS|PERSONALITY|PREFERENCE -> ai_weight. 12) SPEED|SCAL|INTENSITY -> global_intensity. 13) default -> structural_internal. shape: bool_like = all non-null values in {0,1}; enum_like = <=12 distinct values; continuous otherwise. Role + shape + range/sample jointly determine interpretation; keyword misses are auditable via 'matched':null.

global_parameters.note: Name(TEXT)/Value(TEXT) store; values overwhelmingly numeric tunables (AI biases, barbarian tuning, growth exponents, costs). Non-numeric values are engine paths/flags.
